tapussabhallikakunasaññaññīnoṅa: Tapussa and Bhallika, were the first to take refuge in the Buddha, Dhamma, and Sangha.
ta: Ta letter which is 24th letter in 41 letters, it is 16th in 33 Byaññaḥ,in  5-vagga it is being in the place of going (dantaja) ta-vagga and it (nissita)byaññaḥ- alphabet which depends on the first Sara of (dantaja)ta-vagga. Tipi,9,1 ta ta(ti) [tanu+kvi. Tara+kvi] (1) Thief, Robber. (2) The matter of stealing, Attack, Robbery. See - Takkara-(1). (3) Fox, Wild dog, Jackal. (4) Tails of animals (such as elephant, horse). See - Sūci. (5) Merit, Wholesome deed. See - Takkara-(2). (6) Stomach, Belly. See - Takkoṭaka. (7) Water. (8) Treasure. (A) Treasure such as pearl. (b) Treasure such as Buddha, Law and Sangha. (9) Lust. See -Tammaya-(1). Ta lāso(āguṃ)"ta". Tipi,9,2 .Should be changed and chanted from another alphabet which is (ādesa=kāriya)"ta". See origin. Tipi,9,2 ta ta khyera-kyecera-so(lopa)"ta". Tipi,9,2+3 ta ta dhāta, liṅa-tiu့ noka- cīraṅa-sakarokace-apaso paccaññaḥphracaso "ta".  See original. Tipi,9,3+4 ta ta, noun (sabbanāma)"ta" which related with all gender.Tipi,9,4+5+6+7+8+9 ta ta saṅkhyā-ta. (This ta said  6-nos. saṅkhyā by the way of Piṭakasaṅkhyā). See also - Chappaccayadīpaka 88. Tipi,9,9 ta ta(pu) [tara+kvi] Ta sect from  chanaḥ treatise.

[Tana+kvi] (bya) CL=7 [Heto. Thoma. Heto, tanoti, tanu vistāre. Cintāmaṇi.(nīti, sutta. Nhā-378 - See also). (tati-saṃ)] This is two kinds- (A) Have meaning (sātthaka), (B) Meaningless (anatthaka) that is only complete sentence or) (padapūraṇa)"taṃ".  ākhyātavibhata "taṃ". Has meaning (A) Wish for what one"s desire (āsiṭṭha), (B) Urging (ajjhiṭṭha), (C) Apologize (yācana), (D) Evil to others (Sapatha)  "taṃ" etc.,. Tipi,9,10+11 taṃ . (ādesa)"taṃ" which is caused by arrangement of something.  tipi,9,11.

Divine eye) (abhiññāñāṇa means transcendental or supernatural knowledge).

tacatthika: [Taca+atthika] (ti) CL=7 Long for barks of trees, One who want barks (such as one who don"t want to get an essence matter) . See - Taca-(2).

taccha: [Tatha+ya] (na) CL=7 [Tathe sādhu tacchaṃ. Sādhvatthe yo. Dhāna, ṭī. 127. Tathā tatra sādhu yata. Satye, tadvati, ti. Thoma. Cintāmaṇi. Tatha+ṇya. Tathassa bhāvo tacchaṃ....ṇyo. tacchakakamma: [Tacchaka(1)+kamma] (na) CL=7 (A) The matter of Carpenters. (B) The matter of Sculptor.

tacchakāra: [Taccha+kara+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 Woodcutter (who makes living with cutting trees/wood), Carpenter, Architect.

[Taccha+a+iṃ] (kri) CL=7 Have been cut and sculptured. See - Tacchati.
tacchindana: [Ta+chindana] (na) CL=7 Cut and shave that object (such as hairs).

tacchitamaṭṭha: [Tacchita+maṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 Have cut and sculptured, It is smooth because of having cut and sculptured, Have finished both: semi-refined product and finished product.

tacchitaṭṭhāna: [Tacchita+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The place where wood is cut.
tacchiṃ: [Taccha+a+iṃ] (kri) CL=7 Have been cut and sculptured. See - Tacchati.

tacchāpetvā: [Taccha+ṇāpe+tvā] (kā,kri,vi) CL=7 Having cut and sculptured, Having lessened.
tacchārikā: [Ta+chārikā] (thī) CL=7 The ashes of that (dry rice).

tacotthata: [Taca+otthata(=ava+tara+ta)] (ti) CL=7 It is covered with skin (such as calf (of the leg)).

tadabhinīhaṭa: [Ta+abhinī(ni)ha(ta)ṭa] (ti) CL=7 Should makes first and foremost that matter.

tadadhikārānuññāta: [Ta+adhikāra+anuññāta] (ti) CL=7 Should be allowed that matter.

tadagghanaka: [Ta+agghanaka] (ti) CL=7 It is worth to that price.

tadajjhupagata: [Ta+ajjhupagata] (ti) CL=7 Has come close to that object/issue.
tadajjhāsayānukūla: [Tadajjhāsaya+anukūla] (ti) CL=7 In accordance with the desire of these  (beings).

tadantarā: [Ta+antarā] (bya) CL=7 It is being within that (status /period).
tadantogadha: [Ta+antogadha] (ti) CL=7 It is established and believed within that status/issue.

tadanucchavikabhāva: [Tadanucchavika+bhāva] (pu) CL=9 The state of always following to the color of that... the state of being appropriate for that...

tadanukūla: [Ta+anukūla] (ti) CL=7 It is suitable for that object/issue.

[Tamotama+sutta]  CL=10 The Tamotama Sutta is a discourse (that elaborately explains four types of individuals based on their spiritual progression from one life to the next.) These four types are:

4. A person who goes from light to light

tatiyaassādasutta: [Tatiya+assādasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Assāda-sutta, It is third which is Assāda-sutta, A sutta which preaches about have benefits if you know that status and have sin if you don"t know that status ,that is , pleasure on five aggregates of being "assāda",   "ādīnava" (danger (in); problem) that is the five aggregates being , and "nissaraṇa" that is liberation form five aggregates of being.
tatiyaavaṇṇārahasutta: [Tatiya+avaṇṇārahasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Avaṇṇāraha sutta, (1) Speaking (or) Praising the quality of a person who does not subscribe by wisdom and who does not have the quality, (2) Reproaching the person who is good and worth to praise., (3) Monastery, (4) relative donor, (5) Be stingy or jealous on Bribe.
tatiyabhāgādhikasoḷasacittakkhaṇāyuka: [Tatiyabhāga+adhika+soḷasacittakkhaṇa+āyu+ka]  CL=1 (Physical and mental phenomena) that last for a duration equal to 16 mind-moments plus third mind-moment (specifically the dissolution phase), or that last for only 49 sub-moments.
tatiyabhāvanācatukka: [Tatiya+bhāvanācatukka] (na) CL=1 The Third Meditation: The Four Noble Truths
tatiyabhāṇavāra: [Tatiya+bhāṇavāra] (pu) CL=7 The third is recitation cycle, The third recitation sequence.
tatiyabodhisutta: [Tatiya+bodhisutta] (na) CL=7 The third Bodhi Sutta. A sutta which preaches about, once Lord Buddha who meditates Paṭiccasamuppāda dhamma by Anuloma, paṭiluṃ in whole Miuḥsokayāma (small hours of the day)  under Bodhi tree at Nerañjarā river bank in Uruvela forest and preaches thrive. (Paṭiccasamuppāda means arising together from a cause; chain of causation; dependent origination) (Anuloma means regular;not antagonistic; conformity) (paṭiloma means reverse, opposite, contrary).
tatiyacchakka: [Tatiya+chakka] (na) CL=7 It is third Chakka, The section or chapter which preaches all of sum of six kinds of dhamma and preaches three times. (Chakka means hexad; group of six).
tatiyacetanāsutta: [Tatiya+cetanāsutta] (na) CL=7 Third Cetanā sutta, Third Cetanā sutta, A sutta which preaches about base on goodwill which can rotate in Saṃsarā (the circle of rebirths) and cut off Saṃsarā and preaches three times.
tatiyachakka: [Tatiya+chakka] (na) CL=7 It is third Chakka, The section or chapter which preaches all of sum of six kinds of dhamma and preaches three times. (Chakka means hexad; group of six).
tatiyachaphassāyatanasutta: [Tatiya+chaphassāyatanasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Chaphassāyatana sutta, It is third Chaphassāyatana sutta. (Chaphassāyatana means with six sense fields; having six fields of sense impression).
tatiyadassanasamāpatti: [Tatiyā+dassanasamāpatti] (thī) CL=7 Samāpata which concentrates    physical form, know it as should disgust and which is third. (Samāpata means meditation attainment).
tatiyadevacārikasutta: [Tatiya+devacārikasutta] (na) CL=7 The third Devacārika sutta, A sutta which preaches about Lord Buddha itinerary (or) journey to Tāvatiṃsā Deva realm (it is second of the six levels inhabited by Deva or celestial lords) , at that times Buddha preaches to Deva that is the benefit of consequence of five precepts which is fond by Buddha, Dhamma, Sangha and Ariyā and preaches three times.
tatiyadhammasaṅgīti: [Tatiyā+dhammasiṅgīti] (thī) CL=7 Third (dhammasaṅgīti) sutta,They  recite together Abhidhammā, Vinaya. See also - Tatiyasaṅgīti.
tatiyadiṭṭhi: [Tatiyā+diṭṭhi] (thī) CL=7 (Atta) diṭṭhi which is third. (Attadiṭṭhi means speculation about the soul).
tatiyadukkhasutta: [Tatiya+dukkhasutta] (na) CL=7 The Third  dukkha sutta, A sutta which preaches to Bhikkhus that should rejected "chanda" (desire) for five aggregates being and "rāga" (lust) for five aggregates of being which is suffering and preaches three times.
tatiyagamanavagga: [Tatiya+gamanavagga] (pu) CL=7 The third Gamana vagga, It is third that is all of sum of 26 suttas which is recognized by "gamana" saddā.
tatiyagamanābhinīhāra: [Tatiyagamana+abhinīhāra] (pu) CL=7 It makes first and foremost for striving walking posture which is third stage of posture.
tatiyagilānasutta: [Tatiya+gilānasutta] (na) CL=7 Tatiyagilāna sutta, Sutta which preaches about when Buddha is serious illness , Ashin Mahā cunda recited 7 kinds of Bojjhagṅa beside Lord Buddha and the end of listening that dhamma, Lord Buddha standing up and said to Ashin Cunda three times 'that Bojjhagṅa is really good and noble'. (Bojjhagṅa means elements of awakening; factors of enlightenment).
tatiyagiñjakāvasathasutta: [Tatiya+giñjakāvasathasutta] (na) CL=7 The third Giñjakāvasatha sutta, A sutta which preaches about once time Lord Buddha dwells in a monastery (which is made of bricks) which is situated near Ñātika village, Ashin Ānandā addresses formally to Lord Buddha about the next existence of Upāsakā from that village, Lord Buddha answers three times that is person who completely takes refuge in (1) Lord Buddha, (2) Dhamma (3) Sangha, (4) fulfilled with five precepts (which is fond by Ariyās) that is "dhammādāsa" (mirror of the Dhamma ), person fulfilled with that four  "dhammādāsa" who can answer himself for his story (can know oneself for his future or insight).
tatiyahitasutta: [Tatiya+hitasutta] (na) CL=7 The third Hita sutta, A sutta which preaches thrive that is a Bhikkhu who is not fulfilled or observed five precepts etc., that person is not practising for benefit for himself and others.
tatiyaibbhavāda: [Tatiya+ibbhavāda] (pu) CL=7 (1) Accuse and say three times as "Ibbha". (2) The chapter or section which expresses about it accuses and says three times as "Ibbha". See also - Ibbhavāda. (Ibbha means servant; domestic worker; household staff).
tatiyajanasutta: [Tatiya+janasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Jana-sutta, It is third Jana-sutta.
tatiyajjhāna: [Tatiya+jhāna] (na) CL=7 It is third Jhāna, Third Jhāna.
tatiyajjhānabhūmi: [Tatiyajjhāna+bhūmi] (thī) CL=7 The realms which is the consequence of third Jhāna (there is three realms), Third Jhāna realms.
tatiyajjhānasahagata: [Tatiyajjhāna+sahagata] (ti) CL=7 (The dhamma) which is related to third Jhāna.
tatiyajjhānasamaṅgī: [Tatiyajjhāna+samaṅgī] (ti) CL=7 One who attains third Jhāna.
tatiyajjhānasamaṅgīpuggala: [Tatiyajjhānasamaṅgī+puggala] (pu) CL=7 One who fulfilled with third Jhāna.
tatiyajjhānasukha: [Tatiyajjhāna+sukha] (na) CL=7 (A) Peace and tranquil which is the result of third Jhāna, See - Tatiyajjhānavipākasukha. (B) Peace and tranquil which is (related) to third Jhāna, wealth (peace and tranquil) of third Jhāna.
tatiyajjhānavipākasukha: [Tatiyajjhāna+vipākasukha] (na) CL=7 Peace and tranquil which is the result of third Jhāna.
tatiyajjhānūpacāra: [Tatiyajjhāna+upacāra] (pu) CL=7 (Kāmāvacaracittuppāda) It is intended on realm of sense desire which is being near (vicinity) of third Jhāna.
tatiyajjhānūpacārabhūmi: [Tatiyajjhānūpacāra+bhūmi] (thī) CL=7 Avatthā realm which is opportunity of moment of  Kāmāvacara cittuppāda which is intended on realm of sense desire that is being near (vicinity) of third Jhāna.
tatiyaka: [Tatiya+ka] (ti) CL=7 (A) It occurs third day, (illness etc) which causes one time per three days. (B) It is third.
tatiyakaṇḍakīsutta: [Tatiya+kaṇṭa(ṇḍa)kīvanasutta] (na) CL=7 [Vana-alayapuda kye.] tatiyakaṇṭa (ṇḍa)kīvana-sutta, A sutta which preaches about once time, When Ashin Anuruddhā, Ashin Sāriputrā and Ashin Mahā moggallāna who are dwelling in Carissa carandas forest near Sāketa City ,  Ashin Anuruddhā preaches to Ashin Sāriputrā that is, if you meditate on the four kinds of Satipaṭṭhāna again and again, you can attain the noble abhiññāñāṇa and can know thousands of Lokadhātu. (Satipaṭṭhāna means attending mindfully; being present with mindfulness) (Lokadhātu means world system; world sphere).
tatiyakaṇṭakīsutta: [Tatiya+kaṇṭa(ṇḍa)kīvanasutta] (na) CL=7 [Vana-alayapuda kye.] tatiyakaṇṭa (ṇḍa)kīvana-sutta, A sutta which preaches about once time, When Ashin Anuruddhā, Ashin Sāriputrā and Ashin Mahā moggallāna who are dwelling in Carissa carandas forest near Sāketa City, Ashin Anuruddhā preaches to Ashin Sāriputrā that is, if (you) meditates four kinds of Satipaṭṭhāna again and again, (you) can attain the noble abhiññāñāṇa and can know thousands of Lokadhātu. (Satipaṭṭhāna means attending mindfully; being present with mindfulness) (Lokadhātu means world system; world sphere).
tatiyakhatasutta: [Tatiya+khatasutta] (na) CL=7 Tatiya khata-sutta, It is third Khata-sutta, One who is completed with improper body, oral , mind and gesture, that person who should dig out himself (mean dig out no good mind or attitude) and then one who is completed with proper body, oral, mind and gesture, that person who shouldn"t dig out himself (means you have good attitude or mind, it shouldn"t remove those).
tatiyakoṭṭhikasutta: [Tatiya+koṭṭhikasutta] (na) CL=7 Tatiyakoṭṭhika-sutta, A sutta which preaches three times: One who doesn"t know the Fourth Noble Truths , that person fulfilled with "avijjā" who is called "avijjāgata", One who knows the Fourth Noble Truths, that person fulfilled with "Vijjā" who is called "Vijjāgata" by Ashin Mahā koṭṭhika.
tatiyakukkuṭārāmasutta: [Tatiya+kukkuṭārāmasutta] (na) CL=7 Tatiya kukkuṭārāma sutta, A sutta which preaches about : Once time when Ashin Ānandā is dwelling in Kukkuṭāruṃ monastery near Pāṭaliputa Country, Ashin Bhaddha addresses formally to Ashin Ānandā three problems that are "noble practice, person who has noble practice and what is the end of noble practice", Ashin Ānandā answers : 8 kinds of Magga is noble practice such as "sammādiṭṭhi" right viewing, one who fulfilled  that practice which is having noble practice and the cessation of defilement, anger, ignorance which is Nibbāna that is also said the end of the noble practice.
tatiyamagga: [Tatiya+magga] (pu) CL=7 It is third Magga, Anāgāmimagga.
tatiyamaggapaññā: [Tatiyamagga+paññā] (thī) CL=7 Wisdom related to Anāgāmimaga. (Anāgāmimaga means path of a non-returner).
tatiyamaggañāṇa: [Tatiyamagga+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 Wisdom which is (related) to the third Magga, Anāgāmi Magga Wisdom. (Anāgāmimaga means path of a non-returner).
tatiyamaggañāṇavajjha: [Tatiyamaggañāṇa+vajjha] (ti) CL=7 Lust should be rejected by Anāgāmimagga wisdom.
tatiyamoranivāpasutta: [Tatiya+moranivāpasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Moranivāpa sutta, A sutta which preaches about : When Lord Buddha is dwelling in Paribiuja monastery named "moranivāpa" which is near Rājagriuha City, a Bhikku who fulfilled with "sammādiṭṭhi" (right view), "sammāñāṇa" (right knowledge), "sammāvimutti" (correct liberation) who overcomes cessation and destruction of Bhikkhu"s matter which is Nibbāna, that is "accantaniṭṭha" and preaches those dhammas three times.
tatiyanibbānapaṭisaṃyuttasutta: [Tatiya+nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Nibbānapaṭi saṃyuttasutta, A sutta which preaches three times about the dhamma which is related to Nibbāna.
tatiyanāgavimāna: [Tatiya+nāga+vimāna+vatthu.(vatthu-nokapuda] (na) CL=7 [Kye).] Sermon which expresses third (Nāgavimāna) elephant mansion.
tatiyanānātitthiyasutta: [Tatiya+nānātitthiyasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Nānātitthiya sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about it is related argument of Bhikkhu, Brahmin and Itinerant heretic who have different kinds of doctrine.
tatiyanāvāvimāna: [Tatiya+nāvā+vimāna+vatthu] (na) CL=7 Sermon which preaches third (nāvāvimāna) boat, ship mansion.
tatiyaovādasutta: [Tatiya+ovāda+sutta]  CL=9 This is a discourse where the Buddha, having appointed Venerable Mahā Kassapa as his representative with the words 'Just as I instruct and admonish the monks, you too should instruct and admonish them,' discusses the potential future of the monastic community.
tatiyapabbatasutta: [Tatiya+pabbatasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Pabbata sutta, If a pebble which is as large as 7 pieces of Mung Bean seed which compares to Mont Mraṅa့miura, It does not reach to one part of one hundred thousand, like that ,In period beyond the Buddha Era Bhikkhu, Brahmin, Itinerant heretic who know the dhamma , if those dhammas compare to the dhammas which is known by an Ariyasāvaka, it does not reach to one part of one hundred thousand. Sotāpana ariyā persons have great and noble Adhigama, abhiññāña and preaches those dhammas three times. (Adhigama means discovery (of); finding (of); attainment (of); achievement (of); lit. arrival ) (Abhiññāña means transcendental or supernatural knowledge).
tatiyapeyyāla: [Tatiya+peyyāla] (pu,na) CL=7 [Pātuṃ alaṃti peyyālaṃ, vitthāretuṃ alaṃ"thavā. Jālinī. 15.] Third (Brief speech) which able to expand.
tatiyapubbārāmasutta: [Tatiya+pubbārāmasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Pubbārāma sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : when Lord Buddha is dwelling in Pubbāruṃ (East)  monastery near Sāvatthi City, which is monastery is donated by Visākhā who is mother (not blood mother, but good as a mother) of Migāra rich man, An Arhat Bhikkhu who studies and practises "vīriyindriya (power of effort), satindriya ( faculty of awareness), samādhindriya (power of collected mind) who can know and answer Arahattaphala.
tatiyapuññābhisandasutta: [Tatiya+puññābhisandasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Puññābhisanda sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : the flowing of merits (Do merits continuous) that is confidence and take refuge in Buddha, Dhamma and Sangha, fulfilled with Vipassanā wisdom and Magga wisdom.
tatiyapāpadhammasutta: [Tatiya+pāpadhammasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Pāpadhamma sutta, A sutta which preaches about : It has 10 kinds of evil dhamma (deed, word, thought) and one who practises or handles these evil dhamma, it has 10 kinds of sucarita dhamma (good deed) and one who practises or handles these sucarita dhamma.
tatiyapīṭhavimāna: [Tatiya+pīṭha+vimāna+vatthu] (na) CL=7 The sermon revealing about the the golden temple that is similar to the third seat.
tatiyarukkhasutta: [Tatiya+rukkhasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Rukkha sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : The trumpet flowers tree is noble among the trees in Asūrā realm, like that paññindriya which is noble in 37 kinds of Bodhipakkhiya dhamma. (paññindriya means power of wisdom or faculty of understanding) (Bodhipakkhiya means belonging to enlightenment).
tatiyarāsi: [Tatiya+rāsi] (pu) CL=7 It is third and also a set of dhammas (such as Abyākata dhamma). (Abyākata means undeclared (by); unexplained (by); not stated (by); indeterminate).
tatiyasaddhammasammosasutta: [Tatiya+saddhammasammosasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Saddhammasammosa-sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : It can disappear wholesome dhamma (Sāsanā) and can establish these wholesome dhamma.
tatiyasamaṇabrāhmaṇasutta: [Tatiya+samaṇabrāhmaṇasutta] (na) CL=7 The third Samaṇa brāhmaṇa-sutta. See original. (Samaṇabrāhmaṇa means ascetic or Brahman; monk or priest).
tatiyasammattaniyāmasutta: [Tatiya+sammattaniyāmasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Sammattaniyāma-sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : One who has five kinds of dhamma such as makkha who also listens dhamma, can not attain Ariyamagga that is Sammattaniyāma.  (Makkha means smears; dirties) (Sammattaniyāma means path with an inevitable destination).
tatiyasamudayadhammasutta: [Tatiya+samudayadhammasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Samudayadhamma-sutta, A sutta which is preached three times by Ashin Sāriputrā that is, one who has  the wisdom which know as the matter of fact on five aggregates of beings which has the nature of happening and destruction.
tatiyasamādhisutta: [Tatiya+samādhisutta] (na) CL=7 Third Samādhi sutta. See original.
tatiyasattakasutta: [Tatiya+sattakasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Sattaka sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : there is seven kinds of dhamma which can be prosperous for Bhikkhus.
tatiyasaññāvedayitakathā: [Tatiyā+saññāvedayitakathā] (thī) CL=7 A phrase which expresses the third Saññā, vedanā. (Saññā means perceiving; regarding (as)) (Vedanā means felt experience; feeling; sensation; second of the five aggregates).
tatiyasaṃkhittasutta: [Tatiya+saṃkhittasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Saṃkhitta sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : five kinds of indriya they are (Saddhā(faithful), vīriya(effort; energy), sati(existing; being), samādhi(Samādhi), paññā(wisdom).
tatiyasaṅgaha: [Tatiya+saṅgaha] (pu) CL=7 When they convene a Buddha synod for third times.
tatiyasaṅgīti: [Tatiyā+saṅgīti] (thī) CL=7 (A) It is  third times together recitation, Third Saṅgāyanā. (Saṅgāyanā means convene a Buddha synod). (B) A period when they convene a Buddha synod for third times.
tatiyasaṅgītikāla: [Tatiyasaṅgīti+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period when they convene a Buddha synod for third times.
tatiyasikkhāsutta: [Tatiya+sikkhāsutta] (na) CL=7 Third Vinaya sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : three kinds of Vinaya that is Adhisīla, adhicitta, adhipaññā. (Adhisīla means higher virtue; higher conduct) (Adhicitta means meditation; mental development) (Adhipaññā means higher insight; deeper understanding).
tatiyasutasutta: [Tatiya+sutasutta] (na) CL=7 Third sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about: One who listened the issue of dragon that Dragon is ' long life, beautiful, have many wealth' which is  characteristic of dragon , and he concentrates and longs for those dragon, so after he passes away, the next existence is being a dragon.
tatiyasāriputtakoṭṭhikasutta: [Tatiya+sāriputtakoṭṭhikasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Sāriputtakoṭṭhika-sutta, A sutta which preaches three times about : Ashin Sāriputrā teaches to Ashin Mahākoṭṭhika that is , one who is not free from attachment on the five aggregates of being that can be  wrong belief.
tatiyasāvaka: [Tatiya+sāvaka] (pu) CL=7 The disciple (of Buddha) who is third person.
tatiyattabhāva: [Tatiya+attabhāva] (pu) CL=7 Third Attabhāva-upapattibhava. See also - Attabhāva. (Attabhāva means being; creature; animal) (Upapattibhava means resultant existence).
tatiyatthavācaka: [Tatiya+atthavācaka] (ti) CL=7 It preaches meaning (Karaṇa)of Tatiyā(nā)vibhata (such as nipātapada). (nipātapada means (gram) indeclinable; indeclinable part of speech).
tatiyattheravāda: [Tatiya+theravāda] (pu) CL=7 The speech (sound) of third Thera.
tatiyattikānantara: [Tatiyattika+anantara] (ti) CL=7 Point beyond of third Tika (all of sum of three meanings). (Tika means triad; group of three).
tatiyauposathasutta: [Tatiya+upesatha+sutta] (na) CL=7 Third Uposatha-sutta, Saṃsedaja Dragon said ' I do merits and demerits by both body and mind in past (life), so the next existence is being in Saṃsedaja Dragon (race).
tatiyavagga: [Tatiya+vagga] (pu) CL=7 It is all of sum of three articles, Third group.
tatiyavaggabrāhmaṇa: [Tatiyavagga+brāhmaṇa] (pu) CL=7 Brahmin who is inclusive in third group.
tatiyavibhaṅgasutta: [Tatiya+vibhaṅgasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Vibhaṅga sutta, A sutta which preaches three times that is preaching five kinds of indriya (which is Sukha, dukkha, somanassa, domanassa, upekkhā ) by detail and elaborate version.
tatiyavijjā: [Tatiyā+vijjā] (thī) CL=7 The Third Vijjā (Āsavakkhaya wisdom- Arahattamaga wisdom).
tatiyavijjādhigama: [Tatiyavijjā+adhigama] (pu) CL=7 Attaining Arahattamaga wisdom. (Arahattamagga means path of arahantship; path to the full awakened state).
tatiyavijjāsamaññā: [Tatiyavijjā+samaññā] (thī) CL=7 The name which is third Vijjā (of Arahattamaga wisdom). (Arahattamagga means path of arahantship; path to the full awakened state).
tatiyavijjāsiddhi: [Tatiyavijjā+siddhi] (thī) CL=7 It is completion of Arahattamagga wisdom. (Arahattamagga means path of arahantship; path to the full awakened state).
tatiyavimokkha: [Tatiya+vimokkha] (pu) CL=7 Samāpata which is liberation from opposite dhamma (Vimokkha) which is third. (Vimokkha means release (of); freedom (of); emancipation (of); deliverance (of); salvation (of); meditation attainment).
tatiyavinayadharasutta: [Tatiya+vinayadharasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Vinayadhara sutta, Knowing Vinayas which is Āpata , Anāpata, lahukaāpata, garukaāpata, establish or observe Vinaya not stingyly, attaining four stage of Rūpajhāna as per one"s desire, perceive Arahattaphala.
tatiyaviññāṇaṭṭhiti: [Tatiyā+viññāṇaṭṭhiti] (thī) CL=7 It is location of third Viññāña (Paṭisandhe). (Paṭisandhe means rebirth-linking; conception). (Viññāña means awareness; consciousness; mind; fifth of the five aggregates).
tatiyavohārasutta: [Tatiya+vohārasutta]  CL=10 The third sutta that is Vohāra Sutta, the third discourse on the way of speaking where non-noble ones say "not seeing in what is seen, not hearing in what is heard, not experiencing in what is experienced, not knowing in what is known."
tatiyayāma: [Tatiya+yāma] (pu) CL=7 Third portion of night, Small hours of the day.
tatiyañāṇavajjha: [Tatiyañāṇa+vajjha] (ti) CL=7 (The dhamma) which should be rejected and killed by (anāgāmimagga) wisdom which is third. (Anāgāmimagga means path of a non-returner).
tatiyaājānīyasutta: [Tatiya+ājānīyasutta] (na) CL=7 Third Ājānīya-sutta, It is third Ājānīya-sutta, A sutta which preaches Martyr horse which is perfection with five characteristics so it is used for King , like that a Bhikkhu who is fulfilled with six kinds of dhamma , who is worth to worship by people and Devas.
tatiyaāneñja: [Tatiya+āneñja] (na) CL=7 Third āneñja samāpatti, It can not be trembled which is third. (āneñja means immovableness; imperturbable state; unshakability) (Samāpatti means meditation attainment).
tatiyaṭṭhānabhāva: [Tatiyaṭṭhāna+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As it is the matter which is (not worth to do for Arhat person) which is third.
tatiyābhinibbhidā: [Tatiyā+abhinibbhidā] (thī) CL=7 (1) It explodes and comes out (from the shell of Avijjā) which is third times. (2) It is cause of explosive for third times.
tatiyābhisamaya: [Tatiya+abhisamaya] (pu) CL=7 Insight the Four Noble Truths by third Magga wisdom, It is combined with Magga wisdom of the Four Noble Truths which is third (times), Beings are emancipated from Samsara for third times.

taṃtaṃgatisaṃvattanika:
[Taṃtaṃgati+saṃvattana+ṇika]  CL=8 Saṃvattanika:
(a) That which leads to various states of existence (such as hell realms, etc.).
(b) That which is worthy of causing various states of existence.
(c) That which has the effect of bringing about various states of existence.
(d) That which causes various states of existence.
(e) That which has the power to produce various states of existence; (kamma or kilesa) that generates different types of existence.
(References: Majjhima Nikāya Aṭṭhakathā 1.386, Majjhima Nikāya Ṭīkā 3.25, Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī Mahāṭīkā 2.281, Pātimokkha Padattha 139)

taṇhupaya: [Taṇhā+upaya(=upa+i+a)] (pu) CL=7 (1) It clings on (Tebhūmaka dhamma as it"s mine, it"s his property) by craving. (2) (Dhamma) which can clings on (Tebhūmaka dhamma as it"s mine, it"s his property) which is only craving. (Tebhūmaka means hree-tiered; three-storied; triple-layered).
taṇhuppatti: [Taṇhā+uppatti] (thī) CL=7 (1) Causing (or) happening craving, The craving which happens. See - Taṇhuppāda-(2). (3) (Sense, Object) which is cause of happening craving. See - Taṇhuppattikoṭṭhāsa, taṇhuppāda.
taṇhuppattikoṭṭhāsa: [Taṇhuppatti+koṭṭhāsa] (pu) CL=7 For the origin of craving which is (senses, objects).
taṇhuppāda: [Taṇhā+uppāda] (pu) CL=7 (1) it is happening craving. (2) Craving which happened. (3) It is cause of happening craving  that is (four articles they are robe, alms, monastery, medicine).
taṇhuppādahetu: [Taṇhā+uppādahetu] (pu) CL=7 [Taṇhuppāda+hetu] (A) The cause which happens craving (or) It is the cause of happening craving, (B) The cause of happening craving.
taṇhuppādavatthu: [Taṇhuppāda+vatthu] (na) CL=7 It is a root cause of craving (or) It has the origin of craving.
taṇhuppādavikkhambhana: [Taṇhuppāda+vikkhambhana] (na) CL=7 It rejects and gives up craving, Rejection and giving up causing craving.
taṇhupādinna: [Taṇhā+upādinna] (ti) CL=7 (The sense of craving) which can be attached by craving.
taṇhuttara: [Taṇhā+uttara] (ti) CL=7 It has strong craving; Strong craving.
taṇhuttariyadāna: [Taṇhuttariya+dāna] (na) CL=7 It is offerings with strong craving.
taṇhā: [Tasa+ṇha+ā.(dhāna] (thī) CL=7 [(Dhāna, ṭī. 162, 1057). Nīti, dhā. 258- See. Tasa+ha+ā.(sūci- See).] Desire to enjoy or use, (A) (Dhamma) which is cause of hunger, (Dhamma) which can not be satisfied. (B) Want to drink water, Thirsty. [Taṇhā(thī) [tasa+ṇhā. Yo taṃ passati, taṃ tasitaṃ karotīti taṇhā, sa-lopo, ṇhā ca. Dhāna, ṭī. 43.(sūci- See also).] One who is daughter of the archangel of evil and was named craving.
taṇhāavijjāmaya: [Taṇhāvijjā=taṇhāavijjā+maya] (ti) CL=7 It is completion with Taṇhā (craving) and avijjā (ignorance), It is also Taṇhā (craving) and avijjā (ignorance).
taṇhābaddha: [Taṇhā+baddha] (ti) CL=7 One who is bound (or) attached with craving.
taṇhābandhana: [Taṇhā+bandhana] (na) CL=7 The attachment which is craving.
taṇhābandhanabaddha: [Taṇhābandhana+baddha] (ti) CL=7 (All living beings) which can be bound by craving.
taṇhābhavaparikkhīṇa: [Taṇhābhava+parikkhīṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who is cessation of craving and also run out of life.
taṇhābhibhava: [Taṇhā+abhibhava] (pu) CL=7 It is overwhelmed and afflicted by craving.
taṇhābhinandanā: [Taṇhā+abhinandanā] (thī) CL=7 Craving which is strong attachment.
taṇhābhinandanāvega: [Taṇhābhinandanā+vega] (pu) CL=7 The power of craving which is strong attachment.
taṇhābhinandita: [Taṇhā+abhinandita] (ti) CL=7 (Sense) which is pleased with craving.
taṇhābhinivesa: [Taṇhā+abhinivesa] (pu) CL=7 It is concentrated by craving.
taṇhābhinivesapubbaṅgama: [Taṇhābhinivesa+pubbaṅgama] (ti) CL=7 It makes first and foremost for concentration with craving.
taṇhābhirati: [Taṇhā+abhirati] (thī) CL=7 It is pleasured with craving.
taṇhābhisaraṇa: [Taṇhā+abhisaraṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) It aims and goes with craving. (2) Craving which is the cause that is , looking forward and going. See - Anokasārī-(C).
taṇhābhisaṅga: [Taṇhā+abhisaṅga] (pu) CL=7 It is very attached with craving.
taṇhācalana: [Taṇhā+cala+yu] (na,thī) CL=7 (1) It is trembling with craving (or) It is trembling due to craving. (2) It is cause of trembling which is craving. (3) Trembling of craving. (4) Craving which can be trembled.
taṇhācarita: [Taṇhā+carita] (ti) CL=7 It has the gesture and practice which can cause craving, It has mind or desire which can cause craving, One who has the habit of craving. See also - Carita.
taṇhācaritabhāva: [Taṇhācarita+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As it has the characteristic of craving, (Desire and craving) the dhamma which is the cause of knowing that is having the characteristic of craving.
taṇhācaritamanda: [Taṇhācarita+manda] (ti) CL=7 One who is less characteristic of craving, has less craving behavior, One who has weak craving.
taṇhāchadana: [Taṇhā+chadana] (na) CL=7 The dark ignorance which (can be called) craving.
taṇhāchadanachādita: [Taṇhā+chadana+chādita] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who is covered with craving. (B) One who is covered with darkness (means ignorance) which is defilement or craving.
taṇhāchadanavirahita: [Taṇhā+chadana+virahita] (ti) CL=7 One who is free from darkness (means ignorance) that is craving.
taṇhāchakka: [Taṇhā+chakka] (na) CL=7 All of sum of 6 kinds of lust (such as Rūpataṇhā: craving for material form), Six kinds of craving.
taṇhāchanda: [Taṇhā+chanda] (pu) CL=7 It is the desire that arises only from craving (or) 'Desire' which is only craving.
taṇhāchandamūlaka: [Taṇhāchanda+mūla+ka] (ti) CL=7 It has root cause that is  craving.
taṇhāchandarāga: [Taṇhā+chandarāga] (pu) CL=7 Craving which is Longing (and) attachment.
taṇhāchandasahagata: [Taṇhāchanda+sahagata] (ti) CL=7 It is associated with Taṇhāchanda (craving).
taṇhāchandasahita: [Taṇhāchanda+sahita] (ti) CL=7 (Chanda cetasika) which is being together with craving. (Chanda means interest (in); desire (for); wish (for); intention (to); impulse (for)) (Cetasika means mental; related to mind).
taṇhādaḷhatta: [Taṇhā+daḷhatta] (na) CL=7 As It is firm with craving, It is attached firmly with craving.
taṇhādaḷhattadiṭṭhipaccupaṭṭhāna: [Taṇhādaḷhatta+diṭṭhi+paccupaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 (Nature) which makes first and foremost to appear in (wisdom of Yogī person) due to wrong belief (and) the nature of firming of craving.
taṇhādhaja: [Taṇhā+dhaja] (pu) CL=7 (1) Pennant which is craving, Craving which is like pennant.(Ti) (2) One who has pennant that is craving.
taṇhādhanusamuṭṭhāna: [Taṇhā+dhanu+samuṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 It is origin of bow that is craving.
taṇhādhipanna: [Taṇhā+adhipanna] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who is overwhelmed and afflicted by craving. (B) One who subscribes to craving. (C) One, his minds fall in craving.
taṇhādhipannatā: [Taṇhādhipanna+tā] (thī) CL=7 As one who is overwhelmed and afflicted by craving.
taṇhādhipateyya: [Taṇhādhipati+ṇeyya] (ti) CL=7 It is come from that chief which is craving,  It has a chief which is craving, it is the follower of craving.
taṇhādhipati: [Taṇhā+adhipati] (pu) CL=7 Leader which is craving. See - Taṇhādhipateyya.
taṇhādiappavattihetu: [Taṇhā+ādi+appavatti+hetu] (pu) CL=7 (Nibbāna) which is the cause of absence of craving etc.,.
taṇhādiupadhinidāna: [Taṇhā+ādi+upadhi+nidāna] (ti) CL=7 There is a cause which is "upadhi" which is depended place of suffering such as craving. See - Upadhi. (Upadhi means attachment; taking as mine; appropriation; acquisition; sense of ownership; identification;essential ground of existence, substrate of being).
taṇhādiṭṭhibandhana: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+bandhana] (na) CL=7 The bondage which is craving and wrong belief.
taṇhādiṭṭhibheda: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+bheda] (pu) CL=7 It has many kinds of craving (net), Diṭṭhi (net).
taṇhādiṭṭhicchāta: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+chāta] (pu) CL=7 (1) One who wants to enjoy to be hungry with craving, Diṭṭhi (net).
taṇhādiṭṭhigati: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+gati] (thī) CL=7 It causes craving, wrong attitude (such as me, mine).
taṇhādiṭṭhijjhosāna: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+ajjhosāna] (na) CL=7 (1) It is very subscribe to craving and decided with craving. (2) Craving, Diṭṭhi which are cause of excessively subscribe and decision. See also - Ajjhosāna.
taṇhādiṭṭhimamatta: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+mamatta] (na) CL=7 As  it takes and pleasures by craving and wrong belief or attitude as mine.
taṇhādiṭṭhimamattavirahita: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+mamatta+virahita] (ti) CL=7 One who is free from as taking and pleasures on that object or issue as mine by craving and wrong belief or attitude .
taṇhādiṭṭhimānanandanābhirata: [Taṇhādiṭṭhimāna+nandana+abhirata] (ti) CL=7 One who pleasures with craving, wrong attitude and pride.
taṇhādiṭṭhimānappabheda: [Taṇhādiṭṭhimāna+pabheda] (ti) CL=7 There are different types of craving, wrong attitude and pride, They are different kinds of object or issue by craving, wrong attitude and pride.
taṇhādiṭṭhinibbuta: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+nibbuta] (ti) CL=7 It has craving and Diṭṭhi which is already ceased, One who has already cessation of craving and Diṭṭhi.
taṇhādiṭṭhinissaya: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+nissaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) It is dependable place of (Living beings) which is craving and Diṭṭhi. (Ti) (2) it has a supporter of (living being) which is craving, Diṭṭhi. See - Taṇhādiṭṭhinissayatā.
taṇhādiṭṭhinissayatā: [Taṇhādiṭṭhinissaya+tā] (thī) CL=7 As it has depended place of (living beings) that is craving, Diṭṭhi.
taṇhādiṭṭhinissita: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+nissita] (ti) CL=7 One who can be depended on craving, Diṭṭhi.
taṇhādiṭṭhinivesana: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+nivesana] (na) CL=7 The house which is craving, Diṭṭhi. Craving, Diṭṭhi which is like a house.
taṇhādiṭṭhiparittāsa: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+parittā(tā)sa] (pu) CL=7 (1) It fears and trembles with craving, Diṭṭhi. (2) It is cause of trembling which is craving, Diṭṭhi.
taṇhādiṭṭhiparitāsa: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+parittā(tā)sa] (pu) CL=7 (1) It fears and trembles with craving, Diṭṭhi. (2) It is cause of trembling which is craving, Diṭṭhi.
taṇhādiṭṭhipavatta: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+pavatta] (ti) CL=7 Craving, Diṭṭhi which can rotate continuous.
taṇhādiṭṭhisaṃkiliṭṭhasukha: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+saṃkiliṭṭha+sukha] (na) CL=7 (1) (Sensual) pleasure which can be faded and afflicted by craving, Diṭṭhi. (Ti) (The practice) which has (sensual) pleasure which can be faded and afflicted by craving.
taṇhādiṭṭhivipphandana: [Taṇhādiṭṭhi+vipphandana] (na) CL=7 (1) Trembling with lust and contemplation. (2) Trembling with lust and contemplation.
taṇhāduccaritasaṃkilesahetuka: [Taṇhāduccarita+saṃkilesa+hetu+ka] (ti) CL=7 Taṇhā as the nature of worrysome and digusting.
taṇhādutiya: [Taṇhā+dutiya] (ti) CL=8 The one who befriends with lust , Taṇhā.
taṇhādutiyatā: [Taṇhādutiya+tā] (thī) CL=7 As a companion of lust, Taṇhā.
taṇhādutiyikā: [Taṇhā+dutiyikā] (thī) CL=8 Taṇhā as the life partner, wife.
taṇhādvaya: [Taṇhā+dvaya] (na) CL=8 2 types of lust, Taṇhā. Combination of 2 parts of lust.
taṇhādāsa: [Taṇhā+dāsa] (pu) CL=7 The slave of craving, Craving"s slave, Taṇhādāsā sanettikā. Vi, 4. 493. Aṃ, 1. 364.(-ma, 2. 256, 259. Paṭisaṃ. 121. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 211. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 260. Udāna, ṭṭha. 25. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 110. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 16, 34. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 21. Ma, ṭī, 2. 117. Anuṭī, 1. 6. Netti, ṭī. 140).
taṇhādāsabya: [Taṇhādāsa+ṇiya(=bya)] (na) CL=9 Taṇhā+dāsabya. Dāsabya. ( Moga,4. 60. Nīti, sutta. 780) See - Taṇhādāsat.
taṇhādāsatta:
[Taṇhadāsa+tta] (na) CL=8 As a slave of lust, Taṇhā.
About knowing that you are a slave to lust.
taṇhādūta: [Taṇhā+dūta] (pu) CL=8 Slave - Servant of lust, Taṇhā.
taṇhāejā: [Taṇhā+ejā] (thī) CL=7 [Ejakampane. Ejati. Ejā. Ettha ca ejāti lābhādiṃ paṭicca ejati kampatīti ejā, balavataṇhāye"taṃ nāmaṃ. Nīti, dhā. 43.] It is strong craving, Craving which can be tremble. See - Aneja.
taṇhāgahaṇa: [Taṇhā+gahaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Attachment with craving as (mine, my properties). (2) It is the cause of attachment which is as (that"s mine, my properties). (3) It takes craving.
taṇhāgamanavitthāra: [Taṇhā+gamana+vitthāra] (pu) CL=7 The extent of lust; the existence of extensive lust.
taṇhāgata: [Taṇhā+gata] (na) CL=7 (1) "Craving" for attachment on doctrine, Craving which happens together with wrong belief. (Ti) (2) (A) One who comes close with craving. (B) One who happens craving. (C) One who is always following by craving. (D) One who is overwhelmed and afflicted by craving. (E) One who is robbed by craving.
taṇhāgatika: [Taṇhāgata+ṇika] (ti) CL=8 He who has craving, lust, Taṇhā.
taṇhāggahaṇa: [Taṇhā+gahaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Attachment with craving as (mine, my properties). (2) It is the cause of attachment which is as (that"s mine, my properties). (3) It takes craving.
taṇhāggāha: [Taṇhā+gāha] (pu) CL=7 (1) obsession of Lust. (2) lust as a nature of obsession.
taṇhāgāha: [Taṇhā+gāha] (pu) CL=7 (1) It is attached with craving, The cause of attachment which is craving.
taṇhāhara: [Taṇhā+hara] (ti) CL=7 One who can remove and destroy craving.
taṇhāhetuka: [Taṇhā+hetu+ka] (ti) CL=7 (Thing or object etc.,) which has the cause that is craving.
taṇhājaṭa: [Taṇhā+jaṭa] (na,thī) CL=7 It is confusion that is craving.
taṇhājaṭāvijaṭana: [Taṇhājaṭā+vijaṭana] (na) CL=7 Solving the confusion (or) problem that is craving. See also - Vijaṭana.
taṇhājaṭāvijaṭanasamattha: [Taṇhājaṭāvijaṭana+samattha] (ti) CL=7 It able to solve the confusion (or) problem that is craving.
taṇhājeṭṭhaka: [Taṇhā+jeṭṭhaka] (ti) CL=7 There is a chief which is craving, It makes a chief which is craving, (Dhamma) which is the follower of craving.
taṇhājāla: [Taṇhā+jāla] (pu,na) CL=7 It is lace net which is craving, Craving which is like lace net, Craving net or Craving network.
taṇhājālapaliguṇṭhita: [Taṇhājāla+pari+guṇṭhita] (ti) CL=7 One who is wrapping by craving in all direction. One who is wrapping by craving.
taṇhājālinī: [Taṇhā+jālinī] (thī) CL=7 Craving which is like network.
taṇhājālānugata: [Taṇhājāla+anugata] (ti) CL=7 It is following to the network of craving.
taṇhājātika: [Taṇhā+jāti+ka] (ti) CL=7 (Upādāna etc.,) which is cause of happening craving. (Upādāna means acquiring; appropriating; taking possession; grasping; clinging; identifying).
taṇhākappa: [Taṇhā+kappa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Contemplation (or) thinking with craving. It is cause of thinking which is craving.
taṇhākaṇṭaka: [Taṇhā+kaṇṭaka] (pu) CL=7 Craving which is like spike.
taṇhāketu: [Taṇhā+ketu] (pu) CL=7 (1) It is pennant which is craving, Craving which is like pennant. (Ti) (2) One who has a pennant that is craving.
taṇhākkhaya: [Taṇhā+khaya.(rū] (pu) CL=7 [(38, 42-See).] (1) Cessation of "Craving" which is attachment. See - Taṇhakkhayakaraṇa and taṇhakkhayanta.(A) Arahattamagga. (B) Arahattaphala. (C) Nibbāna.
taṇhākkhayabhāva: [Taṇhakkhaya+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As it is cessation of craving which is "Nibbāna".
taṇhākkhayagāmī: [Taṇha(ṇhā)kkhaya+gāmī] (pu) CL=7 (Ariyamagga) which can be attained by (concentration on) Nibbāna which is cessation of craving (attachment).
taṇhākkhayakaraṇa: [Taṇha(ṇhā)kkhaya+karaṇa] (na) CL=7 (Anāgāmimagga) which can make cessation of attachment "sensual pleasure".
taṇhākkhayanta: [Taṇha(ṇhā)kkhaya+anta] (pu,na) CL=7 (A) It is ending period of cessation of craving. (B) It is staring period of cessation of craving. See also - Khīṇanta.
taṇhākkhayasukha: [Taṇhakkhaya+sukha] (na) CL=7 Peace and tranquil of phalasamāpatti. (phalasamāpatti means attainment of the fruit).
taṇhākkhayavimutti: [Taṇha(ṇhā)-kkhaya+vimutti] (thī) CL=7 (1) (A) Arahattaphala which is liberation from defilement due to Taṇhakkhaya "Nibbāna". (B) The practice "Paṭipata" which is cause of liberation from defilement due to Taṇhakkhaya "Nibbāna". (C) Taṇhakkhayavimut sermon. (Ti) (2) One who fulfills with Taṇhakkhayavimutti (arahattaphala). (Arahattaphalaḷāna person). (B) One who falls in Nibbāna by his mind. See - Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti.    (Taṇhakkhaya means  wearing away of craving; depletion of desire; extinction of longing) (Taṇhakkhayavimutti  means liberation by wearing away of craving; release through depletion of desire; freedom by extinction of longing ).
taṇhākkhayādhimutta: [Taṇha(ṇhā)kkhaya+adhimutta] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who realizes Arahattaphala. (B) One who is falling  and attentions on Nibbāna. See - Adhimutta - (1). See also - Nekkhammādhimutta.
taṇhākoṭṭhāsa: [Taṇhā+koṭṭhāsa] (pu) CL=7 It is a part of craving, it is a part of craving among many cravings.
taṇhākāraṇa: [Taṇhā+kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 The cause of attachment. See - Taṇhuppāda-(3).
taṇhākāya: [Taṇhā+kāya] (pu) CL=7 All cravings. A combination of cravings.
taṇhākāyacchida: [Taṇhākāya+chidi+a] (ti) CL=7 One who has a combination of craving. See - Taṇhacchida.
taṇhālakkhaṇa: [Taṇhā+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) The nature of sign of craving. (Ti) (2) It has the sign which is craving.
taṇhālatā: [Taṇhā+latā] (thī) CL=7 The creeper which is craving, Craving which is like creeper.
taṇhālaya: [Taṇhā+ālaya] (pu) CL=7 (Dhamma) which is the cause of attachment again and again which is craving, Craving which is cause of attachment again and again.
taṇhālepa: [Taṇhā+lepa] (pu) CL=7 It is cause of applying which is craving, Craving resin.
taṇhāloluppa: [Taṇhā+loluppa.(abhi,ṭṭha,1.397-krañña့).] (na) CL=7 As one who is attracted with craving again and again, It attracts and takes with force again and again by craving. It wants to get somethings with unseemly ardour (or) It desires to get something seriously.
taṇhāluka: [Taṇhā+ālu+ka] (ti) CL=7 [Ka meaningless]. It has strong attachment, One who has strong craving.
taṇhāmahanta: [Taṇhā+mahanta] (ti) CL=7 It has great craving (greed), One who is (greedy), One who has intense desire.
taṇhāmahogha: [Taṇhā+mahogha] (pu) CL=7 It has great flowing water which is craving, Craving which is great flowing water.
taṇhāmamatta: [Taṇhā+mamatta.(moga] (na) CL=7 [(Pañcikā, 2. 119- See).] As it is attached with craving as it is mine, my properties, It is the cause craving which is as one who is attached with craving as mine , my property.
taṇhāmamāyita: [Taṇhā+mamāyita] (ti) CL=7 (1) (Sense, Thing or object) which can makes it with craving as mine or my property. See - Mamāyita, mamattakaraṇa.
taṇhāmayitavatthu: [Taṇhā+mayita+vatthu] (na) CL=7 Things which can be pleasured by craving, Thing or object which is the sense of craving.
taṇhāmaññanā: [Taṇhā+maññanā] (thī) CL=7 (1) It considers by craving. (2) Craving which is cause of consideration or thinking. (3) It is consideration with pride which can be craving. See - Paññanā.
taṇhāmucchā: [Taṇhā+mucchā] (thī) CL=7 (1) It is confusion due to craving. (2) It is cause of confusion that is craving.
taṇhāmūla: [Taṇhā+mūla] (na) CL=7 (1) It is the root of (life) which is so called craving. (Ti) (2) (Dhamma) which is the origin or root of (life) which is craving. See also - Taṇhāmūladhammasannissaya.
taṇhāmūladhammasannissaya: [Taṇhāmūla+dhamma+sannissaya] (ti) CL=7 It has the support which is the origin dhamma that is craving.
taṇhāmūlaka: [Taṇhā+mūla+ka] (ti) CL=7 (Dhamma) which is root or origin that is craving.
taṇhāmūlakasutta: [Taṇhāmūlaka+sutta] (na) CL=7 Taṇhāmūlaka-sutta, A sutta which preaches 9 kinds of unwholesome dhammas which have the root that is craving, they are acquiring or finding, getting, consideration and decision, intense desire, strong attachment, keeping, misery, guarding or protection, holding or handling weapon such as stick.
taṇhāmūlavisosana: [Taṇhāmūla+visosana] (ti) CL=7 Drying the root of lust (ignorance, etc.); he.
taṇhānadī: [Taṇhā+nadī] (thī) CL=7 The river of lust. Lust like river.
taṇhānandī: [Taṇhā+nandī] (thī) CL=7 Craving is the Dhamma of love. Craving which can be pleasure.
taṇhānati: [Taṇhā+nati] (thī) CL=7 (1) It falls in something with craving. (2) Inclined craving.
taṇhāniddesa: [Taṇhā+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 (1) It expresses craving by detail and elaborate version. (2) The sequence of Saddā which expresses craving by detail and elaborate version.
taṇhānidāna: [Taṇhā+nidāna] (na) CL=7 (1) The cause which is craving. (Ti) (2) (Dhamma) which has the cause which is lust.
taṇhāniggaha: [Taṇhā+niggaha] (pu) CL=7 Suppression the lust. See - Taṇhāniggahattha.
taṇhāniggahattha: [Taṇhāniggaha+attha] (ti) CL=7 Beneficial in suppressing lust (habit, etc.).
taṇhānigghātana: [Taṇhā+nigghātana] (na) CL=7 (1) It completely kills and destroys craving. (Ti) (2) (Dhamma) which is the cause that is completely killed and destroyed craving.
taṇhānighātaka: [Taṇhā+nighātaka] (ti) CL=7 One who can kill and destroy completely craving.
taṇhānimitta: [Taṇhā+nimitta] (na) CL=7 (1) The cause which is craving. (Ti) (2) (Suffering) (due to past misdeeds) which has the cause that is craving. See - Taṇhānimittasaṃsāra.
taṇhānimittasaṃsāra: [Taṇhānimitta+saṃsāra] (pu) CL=7 Suffering (due to past misdeeds) which has the cause that is craving.
taṇhānirodha: [Taṇhā+nirodha] (pu) CL=7 (1) Cessation of craving. (2) It is cessation of craving that is (Nibbāna). See also - Taṇhānirodhagāminī.
taṇhānirodhagāminī: [Taṇhānirodha+gāminī] (thī) CL=7 (Magga practice) which is attained by concentration on Nibbāna that is cessation of craving.
taṇhānirodhasutta: [Taṇhānirodha+sutta] (na) CL=7 Taṇhānirodha-sutta, A sutta which preaches about if you meditate on 7 factors of bojjhaṅga, can attain Nibbāna which is cessation of craving. (Bojjhaṅga means element of awakening; factor of enlightenment).
taṇhānirodhupāya: [Taṇhānirodha+upāya] (pu) CL=7 (Ariyamagga) which is cause of attaining Nibbāna that is cessation of craving.
taṇhānissaya: [Taṇhā+nissaya] (pu) CL=7 It a depended place which is craving, Craving which is supported (dhamma), Craving which can support.
taṇhānissita: [Taṇhā+nissita] (ti) CL=7 (Kammaviññāṇa etc.,) which is depended on craving. (Kammaviññāṇa means consciousness of action).
taṇhānivesana: [Taṇhā+nivesana] (na,thī) CL=7 It is a home which is craving, Craving is a home (means Craving which is like a home). See also - Taṇhādiṭṭhinivesana.
taṇhānivuta: [Taṇhā+nivuta] (ti) CL=7 (Mind etc.,) which is blocked by craving.
taṇhānivāsa: [Taṇhā+nivāsa] (pu) CL=7 The place of craving (or) A home of craving (means craving which is like a house).
taṇhānuga: [Taṇhā+anuga] (ti) CL=7 It is being together with craving, It can follow to craving, It can follow back craving, (Living beings) which is the follower of craving.
taṇhānugata: [Taṇhā+anugata] (ti) CL=7 (A) Subscribe to craving. (B) It is always following by craving. (C) (Mind etc.,) which is always followed to craving.
taṇhānusaya: [Taṇhā+anusaya] (pu) CL=7 It is a latent element which is craving, Craving which happens repeatedly in the sequence of consciousness of beings by being strong cravings, It can happen craving due to get the proper issue. See also - Anusaya.
taṇhānusayamūlaka: [Taṇhānusaya+mūla+ka] (ti) CL=7  (Volitional formations, etc.) which has the root cause that is Taṇhānusaya. (Taṇhānusaya means underlying tendency towards craving; dormant desire).
taṇhānusaṭa: [Taṇhā+anusaṭa] (ti) CL=7 (A) It is spread and covered with craving. (B) (Mind etc.,) which can be run together with craving.
taṇhāpabhava: [Taṇhā+pabhava] (ti) CL=7 (Upādāna etc.,) It has origin which is lust or craving, (Upādāna means fuel (for fire); acquiring; appropriating; taking possession; grasping; clinging; identifying).
taṇhāpabheda: [Taṇhā+pabheda] (pu) CL=7 It has different kinds of craving. Taṇhāpabhedaucchedādi-vatthunā ajjhositā.
taṇhāpaccaya: [Taṇhā+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) The cause which is craving. (2) The cause of craving. See - Taṇhāpaccayakāmaguṇanidāna. (Ti) (3) It has the cause which is craving.
taṇhāpaccayakāmaguṇanidāna: [Taṇhāpaccaya+kāmaguṇa+nidāna] (na) CL=7 (1) It has the cause which is the combination of sensual pleasure which is the cause of craving. (Ti) (2) (Suffering etc.,) it has the cause which is the combination of sensual pleasure which is the cause of craving.
taṇhāpaccayanibbatta: [Taṇhāpaccaya+nibbatta] (ti) CL=7 It happens due to craving which is the cause.
taṇhāpaccayaniddesa: [Taṇhāpaccaya+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 It is explanation for craving by detail and elaborate version.
taṇhāpadaṭṭhāna: [Taṇhā+padaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 (A) It has the closed cause which is craving. (B) It has the depended place (or) supporter which is craving.
taṇhāpadhāna: [Taṇhā+padhāna] (na) CL=7 (1) The prescribed (dhamma) which is craving. (2) Prescribed craving. (Ti) (3) It is prescribed by craving, (Dhamma) which has the prescribed craving.
taṇhāpahāna: [Taṇhā+pahāna] (na) CL=7 (1) Abandonment of craving, free form craving. (Ti) (2) Can give up craving, One who has craving which should abandon. See - Taṇhāpahānaṭṭha.
taṇhāpahānaṭṭha: [Taṇhā+pahāna+attha] (pu) CL=7 (A) As one who gave up craving (or) one who abandoned craving. (B) The nature which is abandonment of craving, It is as one who has craving which should be abandoned.
taṇhāpakkha: [Taṇhā+pakkha] (pu) CL=7 The partner of craving, It is proper craving, (Dhamma) which has the nature of craving.
taṇhāpakkhika: [Taṇhāpakkha+ika] (ti) CL=7 It is inclusive in the partener of craving, (Dhamma) which has the partner of craving.
taṇhāpapañca: [Taṇhā+papañca] (pu) CL=7 (Dhamma) which can be expanded and taken long times by craving.
taṇhāpapañcasaṅkhā: [Taṇhāpapañca+saṅkhā] (thī) CL=7 A set of dhamma which can expand and takes more long times that is craving.
taṇhāparavasa: [Taṇhā+para+vasa] (ti) CL=7 It follows his desire which is craving, one who follows the desire of craving.
taṇhāparetamānasa: [Taṇhā+parebha+mānasa] (ti) CL=7 It has the mind which is followed to craving, It has the mind which is overwhelmed and tortured by craving.
taṇhāpariggaha: [Taṇhā+pariggaha] (pu) CL=7 (1) It is divided and taken by craving. (2) Craving which can divide and take it, it is confiscated by craving.
taṇhāparikkhāra: [Taṇhā+parikkhāra] (pu) CL=7 (A) The surrounded (or) attendants of craving. (B) It can adorn and reform by craving.
taṇhāparitassanā: [Taṇhā+paritassanā] (thī) CL=7 (1) It fears and trembles with craving. (2) It is cause of trembling which is craving. See also - Paritassanā.
taṇhāparitassita: [Taṇhā+paritassita] (na) CL=7 (1) It is trembling with craving. (2) It is cause of tremble which is craving.
taṇhāparivāra: [Taṇhā+parivāra] (pu) CL=7 It is attendants of the craving (or) it is the partners of craving.
taṇhāpariyuṭṭhāna: [Taṇhā+pariyuṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 It is rob and destroy (taking turns of merits) of craving, It is rising up which is craving (or) Rising up of craving. See also - Pariyuṭṭhāna.
taṇhāpariyuṭṭhānadīpaka: [Taṇhāpariyuṭṭhāna+dīpaka] (ti) CL=7 It shows Taṇhā pariyuṭ - ṭhāna, (Verse etc.,) which  shows the state of overwhelming and torture by craving.
taṇhāpariyāya: [Taṇhā+pariyāya] (pu) CL=7 (1) (Saddā such as desire) it is the deception (or) stratagem of craving. (2) Taṇhā (lust) saddā which is the deception (or) ruse (of greed).
taṇhāpariḷāha: [Taṇhā+pariḷāha] (pu) CL=7 Craving which can serious burns and scorches in all directions.
taṇhāparāmāsa: [Taṇhā+parāmāsa] (pu) CL=7 (1) it makes wrong decision with craving. (2) The cause of making wrong decision which is craving.
taṇhāpatthanā: [Taṇhā+patthanā] (thī) CL=7 (1) Longing with craving. (2) It is cause of longing that is craving.
taṇhāpavatti: [Taṇhā+pavatti] (thī) CL=7 (1) It happens craving in succession. (2) It can happen with craving continuously.
taṇhāpañhāsutta: [Taṇhāpañhā+sutta] (na) CL=7 Taṇhāpañhā-sutta, A sutta which is preached by Ashin Sāriputtā to Itinerant heretic named Jambukhādaka that is the practice of 8 kinds of Magga which is the cause of rejection of three kinds of cravings they are sensual pleasure or sense desire, life or state of existence, non-existence or death or annihilation.
taṇhāpaṇidhi: [Taṇhā+paṇidhi] (pu,thī) CL=7 (Dhamma) which is only longing for craving.
taṇhāpaṇidhisosana: [Taṇhāpaṇidhi+sosana] (na) CL=7 It can dry (or) cease craving which has the nature of  longing.
taṇhāpaṇidhivisodhana: [Taṇhāpaṇidhi+visodhana] (na) CL=7 Wiping and cleaning craving which can be long for (something).
taṇhāpaṭinissagga: [Taṇhā+paṭinissagga] (pu) CL=7 The abandonment of craving  which is (Nibbāna).
taṇhāpaṭipakkha: [Taṇhā+paṭipakkha] (ti) CL=7 (1) (The dhamma) which is the opposite of craving. (2) (bhāvappadhāna) which is as the state of opposite of craving.
taṇhāpaṭipassaddhi: [Taṇhā+paṭipassaddhi] (thī) CL=7 It is the cessation of craving which is (Nibbāna). See - Taṇhāpaṭinissaggha.
taṇhāpaṭāka: [Taṇhā+paṭāka] (pu,thī) CL=7 It is a flag (or) pennant which is a flat things that is craving. See - Taṇhādhaja.
taṇhāphandana: [Taṇhā+phandana] (na,thī) CL=7 (1) Trembling with craving. (2) The cause of tremble which is craving.
taṇhāpipāsā: [Taṇhā+pipāsā] (thī) CL=7 (1) It is serious hungry with craving. (2) Craving which is hunger seriously.
taṇhāpipāsāvinayana: [Taṇhāpipāsā+vinayana] (na) CL=7 Elimination  and destroying craving which is hunger seriously.
taṇhāpipāsāvūpasamana: [Taṇhāpipāsā+vūpasamana] (na) CL=7 The cessation of craving which has the nature of hunger.
taṇhāpiyāyanā: [Taṇhā+piyāyanā] (thī) CL=7 (1) Loving with craving. (2) The cause of loving which is craving.
taṇhāppabandhana: [Taṇhā+pabandhana] (na) CL=7 Craving which can combine each and other, Craving succession. See - Taṇhāsota-(B).
taṇhāppavatti: [Taṇhā+pavatti] (thī) CL=7 (1) Craving which is going on continuously. (2) Craving which happens in succession.
taṇhāpurakkhāra: [Taṇhā+pura(re)kkhāra] (pu) CL=7 Craving which is first and foremost.
taṇhāpurekkhāra: [Taṇhā+pura(re)kkhāra] (pu) CL=7 Craving which makes first and foremost as a chief.
taṇhāpāsa: [Taṇhā+pāsa] (pu) CL=7 Craving trap, Craving which is like a trap.
taṇhāpātita: [Taṇhā+pātita] (ti) CL=7 It can be fall down by craving (or) It can be thrown down due to craving.
taṇhārahita: [Taṇhā+rahita] (ti) CL=7 It is already free from craving, It has craving which is already ceased.
taṇhāramaṇa: [Taṇhā+āramma(ma)ṇa] (na) CL=7 The sense which is place of pleasure for craving.
taṇhārammaṇa: [Taṇhā+āramma(ma)ṇa] (na) CL=7 The sense which is place of pleasure for craving.
taṇhārasagiddhika: [Taṇhā+rasa+giddhika] (ti) CL=7 One who enjoys taste with craving.
taṇhārata: [Taṇhā+rata] (ti) CL=7 One who is pleasure with craving.
taṇhāratirahita: [Taṇhā+rati+rahita] (ti) CL=7 Has already free from the pleasure with craving, One who is free from delight with craving.
taṇhāratisanthava: [Taṇhā+rati+santhava] (pu) CL=7 It pleasures with craving, Association with craving.
taṇhāroga: [Taṇhā+roga] (pu) CL=7 Craving which is a disease. Craving which is like a disease.
taṇhārāga: [Taṇhā+rāga] (pu) CL=7 Attachment which is craving, Staining which is craving.
taṇhārāma: [Taṇhā+ārāma] (ti) CL=7 One who has pleasure with craving. See - Taṇhārata.
taṇhāsabhāva: [Taṇhā+sabhāva] (pu) CL=7 (1) The nature of craving. (Ti) (2) (Dhamma) which has the nature of craving.
taṇhāsahagata: [Taṇhā+sahagata] (ti) CL=7 [Taṇhā+saha+gata] (1) Attachment which is "craving". (Sahagata-saddā meaningless). (2) It is mixed with attachment (craving).
taṇhāsahajātavedanā: [Taṇhāsahajātā+vedanā] (thī) CL=7 Suffering which happens together with craving.
taṇhāsahita: [Taṇhā+sahita] (ti) CL=7 (Body etc.,) which is together with craving.
taṇhāsahāya: [Taṇhā+sahāya] (pu) CL=7 (1) It is a partner which is craving. (Ti) (2) (Ignorance etc.,) which has the partner that is craving. See also - Taṇhādutiya.
taṇhāsahāyaviraha: [Taṇhāsahāya+viraha] (pu) CL=7 It is free from partner which is craving.
taṇhāsajjana: [Taṇhā+sajjana] (na,thī) CL=7 (1) It clings with craving. (2) Craving which is cause of clinging.
taṇhāsalla: [Taṇhā+salla] (pu,na) CL=7 Craving which is spike or arrow, Craving which is like an arrow or spike, Craving spike.
taṇhāsamaṇa: [Taṇhā+samaṇa] (ti) CL=7 (Milk etc.,) which can cure huger.
taṇhāsambhūta: [Taṇhā+sambhūta] (ti) CL=7 It causes and develops due to craving. See - Āhārasambhūta.
taṇhāsammudita: [Taṇhā+sammudita] (ti) CL=7 One who is taking pleasure in craving. See also - Taṇhārata.
taṇhāsampayutta: [Taṇhā+sampayutta] (ti) CL=7 (Mind etc.,) which is related to craving collectively.
taṇhāsamudaya: [Taṇhā+samudaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) It happens together with (another cause) of craving which is obvious. (Ti) (2) It has the cause which is craving.
taṇhāsamudda: [Taṇhā+samudda] (pu) CL=7 Craving which is like ocean that is hard to fill, Craving ocean (means so vast and difficult to satisfy).
taṇhāsamudācāra: [Taṇhā+samudācāra] (pu) CL=7 It is being together with craving which happens a section and than a section which is continuous, Craving which happens non-stop. See - Taṇhāpavatti. See also - Taṇhāvicarita - (A).
taṇhāsannissaya: [Taṇhā+sannissaya] (ti) CL=7 It has depended place or supporter which is craving. See - Taṇhāpadaṭṭhāna-(B).
taṇhāsannissita: [Taṇhā+sannissita] (ti) CL=7 It depends on craving, (Form etc.,) which is related to craving.
taṇhāsanthava: [Taṇhā+santhava] (pu) CL=7 It is mixed with craving, It is associated to craving.
taṇhāsanthavavirahita: [Taṇhāsanthava+virahita] (ti) CL=7 One who is free from association with craving.
taṇhāsantāpa: [Taṇhā+santāpa] (pu) CL=7 (1) It is intense burning with craving. (2) Craving which is intense burning and scorching. See also - Itivuta.
taṇhāsantāsa: [Taṇhā+santāsa] (pu) CL=7 (1) It feels serious frighten due to craving. (2) Craving which can be frightened seriously.
taṇhāsara: [Taṇhā+sara] (pu) CL=7 The river which is craving, Craving which is like a river. (means non-stop flowing).
taṇhāsaññojana: [Taṇhā+saṃyojana=saññojana] (na) CL=7 (1) The bondage which is craving, the bondage of craving which is like a string, Attachment which is craving. (Ti) (2) One who has the bondage which is craving. (B) One who has bound with craving.
taṇhāsaṃkilesa: [Taṇhā+saṃkilesa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Craving which can cause weary and torture the beings which is dwelling by that craving, Craving which can be weary (the mind). Defilement of (mind) which is craving. (Ti) (2) Has craving which can worry and defilement.
taṇhāsaṃkilesabhāgiya: [Taṇhā+saṃkilesa+bhāgiya] (ti) CL=7 It is related to the part of craving which can be worry and weary (the mind), (Sermon etc.,) which comes close to craving which can worry and dirt (the mind).
taṇhāsaṃkilesapahāna: [Taṇhāsaṃkilesa+pahāna] (na) CL=7 Rejection of craving that causes worrying and weary mind.
taṇhāsaṃkilesappahāna: [Taṇhāsaṃkilesa+pahāna] (na) CL=7 Rejection of craving that causes worrying and weary mind.
taṇhāsaṃkilesavisodhana: [Taṇhāsaṃ-kilesa+visodhana] (na) CL=7 Cleaning out craving which can be worry and weary (mind).
taṇhāsaṃsīvana: [Taṇhā+saṃsīvana] (na) CL=7 (1) Meeting together with craving. (2) The cause of meeting which is craving.
taṇhāsaṃyojana: [Taṇhā+saṃyojana=saññojana] (na) CL=7 (1) The bondage which is craving, the bondage of craving which is like a string, Attachment which is craving. (Ti) (2) One who has the bondage which is craving. (B) One who has bound with craving.
taṇhāsaṃyutta: [Taṇhā+saṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 (A) It mixed with craving, One who is being as mixing with craving. (B) It is combined and compared with the sense of craving, One who combines and compares on the sense of craving, One who is being as compared with the sense of craving. See also - Avijjāsaṃyutta.
taṇhāsaṅga: [Taṇhā+saṅga] (pu) CL=7 (The dhamma) which clings on the (sense) which is craving, Craving which can clings on sense.
taṇhāsaṅgha: [Taṇhā+saṅgha] (pu) CL=7 All Cravings, a combination of cravings. See - Taṇhāsaṅga.
taṇhāsaṅghāta: [Taṇhā+saṅghāta] (pu) CL=7 (A) All cravings, a combination of cravings, a group of cravings. (B) A beam which is craving. (mean craving which is like a beam (of house)).
taṇhāsaṅghātapaṭimukka: [Taṇhāsaṅghāta+paṭimukka] (ti) CL=7 (A) Should put (include) in, One who is inclusive in lust. (B) Should include (put in) the beam (of a house), One who put in the beam of lust. See - Taṇhāsaṅghāṭapaṭimukka.
taṇhāsaṅghāṭa: [Taṇhā+saṅghāṭa] (pu) CL=7 (A) All cravings, A combination of craving, A group of cravings. (B) It is a beam which is craving. (means Craving which is like a beam (of a house)).
taṇhāsaṅghāṭapaṭimukka: [Taṇhāsaṅghāṭa+paṭimukka] (ti) CL=7 (A) Should put (include) in, One who is inclusive in craving. (B) Should include (put in) the beam (of a house), One who put in the beam of craving. See - Taṇhāsaṅghāṭapaṭimukka.
taṇhāsaṅkhaya: [Taṇhā+saṅkhaya] (pu) CL=7 (Ariyamagga) which can cease completely craving. (2) (Ariyamagga) which is the cause of cessation of craving. (3) (Nibbāna) which is completely cessation of craving. See - Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutta,taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti.
taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutta: [Taṇhāsaṅkhaya+vimutta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is already liberation from (suffering (due to past misdeeds)) by Ariyāmagga.
taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti: [Taṇhāsaṅkhaya+vimutti] (thī) CL=7 (1) (A) Arahattaphalasamāpata  which is especially liberation from craving by concentration on Nibbāna. (B) Arahattaphalasamāpata which is the result of Ariyamagga. (C) Arahattaphalasamāpata which is the end of Ariyamagga. (2) Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti sermon, Sutta which is the cause of attaining  Arahattaphala.
taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttisutta: [Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti+sutta] (na) CL=7 Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutta sutta, A sutta which preaches about Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti. See - Taṇhakkhayavimutti-(1). (Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutti means liberation through the extinction of craving).
taṇhāsaṅkhāta: [Taṇhā+saṅkhāta] (ti) CL=7 (A) A portion or set which is craving. (B) It (should be called or counted) "craving". (C) (Kamma etc.,) which can be preached with craving.
taṇhāsaṅkhātadutiya: [Taṇhāsaṅkhāta+dutiya] (pu) CL=7 It is a second partner which is so called craving. See - Adutiya.
taṇhāsaṅkhātalatā: [Taṇhāsaṅkhāta+latā] (thī) CL=7 Creeper which is so called craving. ( means Craving which is like a creeper (or) very long ).
taṇhāsaṅkhātapabhava: [Taṇhāsaṅkhāta+pabhava] (pu) CL=7 (The origin or root cause) which is start happening  craving (result).
taṇhāsaṅkhātavānavivitta: [Taṇhāsaṅkhāta+vāna+vivitta] (ti) CL=7 It is ceased the dhamma which can meet together which is craving. See - Taṇhāvānavirahita.
taṇhāsineha: [Taṇhā+sineha] (pu) CL=7 Resin which is craving, Craving which is like the resin.
taṇhāsinehamakkhita: [Taṇhāsineha+makkhita] (ti) CL=7 It applies with resin which is craving.
taṇhāsinehasinehita: [Taṇhāsineha+sinehita] (ti) CL=7 It is wet with resin which is craving.
taṇhāsinehasīta: [Taṇhāsineha+sīta] (na) CL=7 The cool (feeling cool) which is craving, Craving which is like cool.
taṇhāsita: [Taṇhā+sita] (ti) CL=7 One who depends on craving.
taṇhāsneha: [Taṇhā+sneha] (pu) CL=7 The resin which is craving, Craving which is like resin.
taṇhāsneharāga: [Taṇhāsneha+rāga] (pu) CL=7 Attachment which happens due to the resin of craving.
taṇhāsnehasaṃsussana: [Taṇhāsneha+saṃsussana] (na) CL=7 Dryness of the resin which is craving.
taṇhāsnehasnehita: [Taṇhāsneha+snehita] (ti) CL=7 It can wet with the resin which is craving.

taṇhānimittasasāra: [Taṇhānimitta+saṃsāra] (pu) CL=7 Suffering (due to past misdeeds) which has the cause that is craving.
taṇhāsakilesa: [Taṇhā+saṃkilesa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Craving which can cause weary and torture the beings which is dwelling by that craving, Craving which can be weary (the mind). Defilement of (mind) which is craving. (Ti) (2) Has craving which can worry and defilement.
taṇhāsakilesabhāgiya: [Taṇhā+saṃkilesa+bhāgiya] (ti) CL=7 It is related to the part of craving which can be worry and weary (the mind), (Sermon etc.,) which comes close to craving which can worry and dirt (the mind).
taṇhāsakilesapahāna: [Taṇhāsaṃkilesa+pahāna] (na) CL=7 Rejection of craving that causes worrying and weary mind.
taṇhāsakilesappahāna: [Taṇhāsaṃkilesa+pahāna] (na) CL=7 Rejection of craving that causes worrying and weary mind.
taṇhāsakilesavisodhana: [Taṇhāsaṃ-kilesa+visodhana] (na) CL=7 Cleaning out craving which can be worry and weary (mind).
taṇhāsasīvana: [Taṇhā+saṃsīvana] (na) CL=7 (1) Meeting together with craving. (2) The cause of meeting which is craving.
taṇhāsayojana: [Taṇhā+saṃyojana=saññojana] (na) CL=7 (1) The bondage which is craving, the bondage of craving which is like a string, Attachment which is craving. (Ti) (2) One who has the bondage which is craving. (B) One who has bound with craving.
taṇhāsayutta: [Taṇhā+saṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 (A) It mixed with craving, One who is being as mixing with craving. (B) It is combined and compared with the sense of craving, One who combines and compares on the sense of craving, One who is being as compared with the sense of craving. See also - Avijjāsaṃyutta.
taṇhāsnehasasussana: [Taṇhāsneha+saṃsussana] (na) CL=7 Dryness of the resin which is craving.
